prompt: Mono blue skies/stompy deck that has some stax pieces and some creatures to kill with

results.prompt: Mono blue skies/stompy deck that has some stax pieces and some creatures to kill with
results.text:
I built a Mono-Blue Skies-Stax deck for Modern. It's a brew, since no current results show a mono-blue skies list.

**Directions I considered**
1. **Blue Eldrazi stompy.** Eldrazi Temple, Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice/Trinisphere. Rejected because colorless lands fight with all the double-blue costs.
2. **Mono-blue artifact stompy, borrowing from Affinity.** Rejected because it isn't really skies, and Affinity already does that better.
3. **Blue fliers plus a stax shell (chosen).** It takes the blue counterspells and threats from Frog and Murktide and the Chalice/Trinisphere stax package from Eldrazi Tron. I picked it because it fits both halves of your request, and every creature has flash or costs 2+, so Chalice on 1 never hits our own cards.

**The plan**
- **Turns 2–3, the lock:** Chalice of the Void on 1 shuts off Bolt, Ragavan, Guide of Souls, Ancient Stirrings, Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. After that, pick by matchup:
  - **Harbinger of the Seas** turns every nonbasic land into an Island, which shuts down Temple, Tron, Amulet and multicolor mana.
  - **Trinisphere or Damping Sphere** for decks full of cheap spells or ritual chains.
  - **Narset** for decks that draw a lot.
- **Then, the fliers:** Faerie Mastermind, Wan Shi Tong, Subtlety, Brazen Borrower and Quantum Riddler (4/6 flier, or warp it early for a card). Two Mutavaults add a land that can attack. Counterspell, Force of Negation and Sink into Stupor protect the lock and the threats.
- **Odds:** you'll see at least one lock piece by turn 3 in 92.5% of games and a flier in 96.2%. The win is aimed at about turn 7.
- The checker said drawing every card named in the win line by then happens only 0.9% of the time. That's misleading: you never need all of them, just a lock piece, a couple of fliers and backup.

**Things to know**
- **Card choices:** Faerie Mastermind shows up in no recent Modern lists. I kept it anyway because it's a 2-mana flash flier that Chalice on 1 doesn't hit. I also swapped Kitesail Larcenist out for Wan Shi Tong (196 lists). It grows and draws every time the opponent cracks a fetchland or tutors, which almost every top deck does.
- **Sequencing:** Trinisphere also taxes your own 2-drops, so play Mastermind or Wan Shi Tong first.
- **Lands:** 19 lands plus 3 Sink into Stupor, which can be played as a land. That's more than Murktide's 18 because this deck has no cheap card-draw spells and wants to hit 3–4 mana every game.
- **Sideboard:** built for the current top decks. Consign to Memory, Dress Down and Pithing Needle are for Broodscale and Devoted Druid. Stern Scolding is for Energy, Prowess and Zoo, Hurkyl's Recall for Affinity, Relic for graveyard decks, and Mystical Dispute for blue decks. Consign, Stern Scolding, Relic and Pithing Needle cost 1, so they don't mix well with your own Chalice on 1.

deck.label: brew
deck.donor: Murktide / Frog (mono-blue interaction suite) + Eldrazi Tron stax package

winLine.does: Turn 2 on X=1: shuts off Bolt, Swiftspear, Ragavan, Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, Ancient Stirrings, Fatal Push, Thoughtseize. The main deck has zero 1-drops, so it never hurts us.

Turn 3: makes every nonbasic land an Island, which stops Eldrazi Temple, Tron, Amulet bounce lands, Urza's Saga and multicolor manabases. Use Trinisphere or Damping Sphere instead when the opponent plays mostly basics or lots of cheap spells.
A flash 2/1 flier that starts the clock and draws cards off opponents' extra draws.
A flash flier that grows and draws a card every time the opponent cracks a fetchland or tutors.
Warp for 1U early to draw a card, or hard-cast later as a 4/6 flier that closes the game.
Holds up protection for the lock pieces and threats while the fliers attack, along with Force of Negation and Subtlety.
Petty Theft bounces a blocker or answer, then the 3/1 flash flier adds damage to finish the game.

needs.role: Lock pieces that land on turns 2-3 so the opponent is slowed while fliers attack
Evasive or hard-to-answer threats that win through the lock
Counterspells to protect the lock from artifact removal and bounce

cardNoteResponses.response: The player asked for a mono-blue skies deck. Its 2-drop has to be a blue flash flier that costs more than 1 so it doesn't run into our own Chalice on 1. The played options (Tamiyo, Spell Pierce-style 1-drops) all cost 1 and would get countered by our own Chalice. Mastermind also punishes Expressive Iteration, Quantum Riddler and other extra draws, and it's a Trinisphere-proof threat when cast before the sphere.

card_info shows Damping Sphere in 1657 Modern lists over the last 90 days (Affinity, Blink, Broodscale). Here it's a main-deck stax piece against Storm rituals, Prowess chaining spells, Eldrazi Temple, Tron and Amulet bounce lands, which is exactly the job the player asked for.

partnerHints.message: Trinisphere: 93% of the 330 modern lists that run it are Eldrazi Tron, and 100% play it alongside Kozilek's Command, which this deck doesn't have. It's usually there for a job that needs Kozilek's Command. Cut it, or say what it does here.
